data.name: Chick
data.detailed_description:
This is a focus tool—and a travel story written together with a girl.

Xiaoman rides this green train. A book-loving girl who wants to see the vast world she reads about. On her journey, sometimes she wishes for someone who understands her to keep her company. Outside the window: fields, mountains, grasslands—different every day, yet always the same. She cradles Ji'er, a plush chick sewn by her grandmother. It can't talk, but a wink means hello.

While you focus, she reads her book. Window light falls on the pages. Ji'er rests by the corner of the book, watching her for you. When you rest, she shares the view—what that mountain looks like, what river just passed by, what her grandmother used to sell at some station platform. Close the window, she closes her book. Open it next time, she's still there.

■ Focus & Journey
Built-in Pomodoro timer. Each session pulls the train one station forward. Fields turn green to gold and back. Her book turns from first page to last, then another begins. Your focused hours push her journey forward, step by step.

■ To-Do List
Write down what you need to do today. Sometimes Xiaoman asks, "Did you finish that thing?" If you did, she's happy for you. If you didn't, that's okay—Ji'er gives you a wink, which means "tomorrow is another day."

■ Music Player
Train wheels humming over tracks. Wind outside the window. Songs she hums. Some melodies unlock as the journey unfolds. Some are meant to be played when the time is right. What you hear is part of her journey, too.

■ Chapter Review
Revisit unlocked chapters anytime. Some answers are hidden in past landscapes. Some words, only when you look back, do you realize were meant for you.

Not every day is clear skies. A storm will come. The signal will cut. You'll see an empty seat, only Ji'er remaining. Some connections come back. Some don't. Your choices shape the direction of the story. But no matter what happens—she will be in her seat. Holding Ji'er. Looking out the window. Ji'er gives you a wink. A wink means someone's there. It means—you've still got time. The journey is long, and you don't have to rush.

data.short_description: Travel with a girl on a train. See the views. Focus on what matters. On a green train, a book-loving girl cradles her plush chick, Ji'er. Through an old communicator, she connects with you. A wink from Ji'er means hello. She reads while you focus. She shares the view when you rest.
data.supported_languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Vietnamese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX8320
  • Memory: 6 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / Radeon HD7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
